title: Tietze–Urysohn: a field continuous on compact C ⊆ V with |f| ≤ 1 extends to a compactly supported continuous unit field in V
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N). Let C ⊆ ℝ^N be compact, let V ⊆ ℝ^N be open with C ⊆ V, and let f : ℝ^N → ℝ^N be continuous on C with |f(x)| ≤ 1 for all x ∈ C. Then there is a continuous g : ℝ^N → ℝ^N such that g has compact support, tsupport g ⊆ V, |g(x)| ≤ 1 for every x ∈ ℝ^N, and g(x) = f(x) for every x ∈ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (C V : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn N), IsCompact C → IsOpen V → C ⊆ V → ContinuousOn f C → (∀ x ∈ C, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → ∃ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, g x = f x
